title: Severe issues since ios17 update
body:
I have a 14 pro max 256gb.
I've been using Notes for many years.
Since i updated to ios17, i'm facing severe issues.
The app crashes - quits automatically.
It consumes a heavy amount of data each time i open it.
The phone heats up a lot.
I'm using it to scan documents. Before the update a 20 pages document was around 5mb. Now it is around 400-500mb!!

Please fix it asap.
